BiblicalUsage: Eldaah is a son of Midian. In Genesis 25:4, the text says "and Eldaah. All these [were] the children of Keturah." The life behind the name is told on the Eldaah People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Eldaah matters because God knows His people by name, and Eldaah is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
